title: rubus corylifolius subsp. lagerbergii
intro: Rubus corylifolius subsp. lagerbergii, commonly known as the Himalayan Raspberry, is a rare species of raspberry native to the Himalayan region. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rubus corylifolius subsp. lagerbergii are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and exhibit antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
